title.en: Writing the rule into the table

hints.tr: "İki parçada aynı olamaz" `UNIQUE`, "sıfırdan büyük olmalı" `CHECK (...)`. İkisi de sütun tanımının sonuna yazılabiliyor.
hints.en: "No two alike" is `UNIQUE`, "above zero" is `CHECK (...)`. Both can go at the end of the column definition.

hints.tr: Sıfırdan **büyük**: `price > 0`. `>= 0` yazarsan sıfır fiyatlı bir parça kabul ediliyor ve kontrol onu deniyor.
hints.en: **Above** zero: `price > 0`. With `>= 0` a part priced at zero is accepted, and the check tries exactly that.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE TABLE parts (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    sku NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0)
);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE TABLE parts (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    sku NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0)
);
```

checks.query: SET NOCOUNT ON; BEGIN TRY INSERT INTO parts (id, sku, price) VALUES (1, 'A-100', 25.00); SELECT 'accepted' AS result; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT 'rejected' AS result; END CATCH
SET NOCOUNT ON; BEGIN TRY INSERT INTO parts (id, sku, price) VALUES (2, 'A-100', 30.00); SELECT 'accepted' AS result; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT 'rejected' AS result; END CATCH
SET NOCOUNT ON; BEGIN TRY INSERT INTO parts (id, sku, price) VALUES (3, 'B-200', -4.00); SELECT 'accepted' AS result; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT 'rejected' AS result; END CATCH
SET NOCOUNT ON; BEGIN TRY INSERT INTO parts (id, sku, price) VALUES (4, 'C-300', 0); SELECT 'accepted' AS result; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT 'rejected' AS result; END CATCH
